entries.summary: Clipboard bridge wakes Wine's clipboard window every 0.5 s: Wine 11.0 acquire_selection() lacks XFlush, so LINE copies never reached the host and host pastes bounced back as stale LINE content
Clipboard reads stream through read_capped and kill xclip once LIMIT is exceeded, instead of buffering the whole selection before checking the cap

next: Make the Xephyr title-bar close button minimize instead of ending the LINE session
